subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — owners, calendar, and Zoom ops
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Mark Chu <mark.chu@atlashealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — owners, calendar, and Zoom ops

Hi Sara / Mark —

Thanks again for the time last week. We put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and would like to kick off a short alignment meeting next week to: confirm owners, align on evaluation success criteria, and lock a close timeline for the PoC.

Proposed logistics:
- 45 minute sync (we’ll keep it tight)
- Goals: confirm stakeholders, approve evaluation milestones, agree on acceptance criteria and next steps for procurement

Tentative slots I can offer: Tue 6/22 10:00–10:45 PT, Tue 6/22 16:00–16:45 PT, Wed 6/23 09:00–09:45 PT. Let me know which works for you and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attached: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (handy 1-page view) and a quick SOW timeline stub.

Quick ask: could you confirm who from Atlas will own the technical evaluation and who will be the procurement contact so I can include them on the invite?

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: SOW_Timeline_v0.9.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@atlashealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Chu <mark.chu@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Desk <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — owners, calendar, and Zoom ops

Thanks Diego — Tue 6/22 10:00 PT works for our team.

Quick notes on owners:
- Technical lead for evaluation: Mark Chu (copied)
- Procurement contact: procurement@atlashealth.com (copied)
- Executive sponsor: Sara Ellis (myself)

Please include a quick agenda (bullet points) and the Zoom link in the invite. Also would be great to call out the acceptance criteria you expect to validate during the PoC (performance, latency, and data handling).

See you then.

— Sara
Director of Data Strategy, Atlas Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@atlashealth.com>, Mark Chu <mark.chu@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Desk <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Calendar invite: MAP kickoff — Tue 6/22 10:00 PT (Zoom link + draft agenda)

Hi all —

Invite is attached and on the calendar. Zoom link below. Agenda draft is inline. I’ve flagged the primary owners per Sara’s note.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=mapkickoff
Dial-in (US): +1 415 555 0199

Draft agenda (45m):
1) Welcome & outcome (5m) — Diego / Sara
2) MAP walkthrough & roles (10m) — Diego
3) Evaluation plan & acceptance criteria (15m) — Mark / Diego
   - latency targets, throughput, tolerance for hallucination, data handling notes
4) Procurement & timeline (10m) — Procurement Rep / Laura
5) Next steps & action owners (5m)

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, SOW_Timeline_v0.9.xlsx

Notes for Atlas: if there are any security/compliance docs you need ahead of the call (SOC 2, data retention policy), Laura will include links in the follow-up.

Diego
Attachment: MAP_Draft_v1.pdf
Attachment: SOW_Timeline_v0.9.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Chu <mark.chu@atlashealth.com>, Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Desk <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Calendar invite: MAP kickoff — Tue 6/22 10:00 PT (Zoom link + draft agenda)

Diego — quick internal note before the kickoff:

I’ll own the security/compliance slot and will post links to: SOC 2 summary, data retention matrix, and our network isolation notes in the Drive folder before the call. Priyom, can you bring the measurement plan (what logs we’ll capture, how we’ll measure latency/throughput) and be prepared to speak to expected token costs for the PoC?

Priyom — I’ll add you as co-host on the Zoom invite.

Thanks —
Laura
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Mark Chu <mark.chu@atlashealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Ellis <sara.ellis@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Desk <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Calendar invite: MAP kickoff — Tue 6/22 10:00 PT (Zoom link + draft agenda)

Thanks Diego — calendar invite received and confirmed.

I’ll go through the MAP and highlight the technical acceptance criteria my team will evaluate. We’ll also bring a quick list of the internal test prompts and a performance baseline from our staging environment.

Procurement — we’ll follow up on contracting cadence after the kickoff.

Look forward to it.

— Mark Chu
Head of Platform Engineering, Atlas Health
